claims.text: The hotel is at 1 West 28th Street, at the corner of Fifth Avenue and West 28th Street in Manhattan's NoMad neighborhood.

findings.quote: located at **1 West 28th Street, New York, NY 10001**, at the corner of Fifth Avenue and West 28th Street in Manhattan’s NoMad (North of Madison Square Park) neighborhood

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, the Empire State Building, Fifth Avenue shopping, Eataly and Koreatown.

findings.quote: The hotel is within walking distance of Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, Empire State Building, Fifth Avenue shopping, Eataly, Koreatown

claims.text: The hotel is built on the former estate of Mrs. Charlotte Goodridge, a Gilded Age hostess.

findings.quote: The Fifth Avenue Hotel is built on the former estate of Mrs. Charlotte Goodridge, a legendary Gilded Age hostess

claims.text: The mansion housed a fine art gallery before architects McKim, Mead & White reimagined it as the Second National Bank.

findings.quote: The mansion then housed a fine art gallery before being reimagined by legendary architectural firm McKim, Mead & White as the stately Second National Bank.

claims.text: The restored 1907 landmark mansion stands beside a contemporary glass tower.

findings.quote: Before it was ours, this Fifth Avenue mansion had worn a few different guises.
the restored 1907 landmark stands beside a contemporary glass tower

claims.text: Pae White's Bugs & Drugs tapestry hangs in the lobby.

findings.quote: Pae White’s Bugs & Drugs tapestry invites wonder into the lobby

claims.text: Photographs by William Klein, Gordon Parks and Melvin Sokolsky hang on the walls.

findings.quote: Photographs by William Klein, Gordon Parks, and Melvin Sokolsky adorn the walls

claims.text: All rooms have marble bathrooms, stocked maxibars, Nespresso coffee makers and a personal tablet to manage the room.

findings.quote: All rooms have generously sized marble bathrooms and amenities including thoughtfully stocked maxibars, Nespresso coffee makers and a personal tablet to manage your comfort

claims.text: Each room has complimentary soft drinks and snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi and a personal tablet.

findings.quote: a personal tablet, high-speed Wi-Fi, and complimentary soft drinks and snacks in each room

claims.text: Around-the-clock butler attendance is included.

findings.quote: Around-the-clock butler attendance is included here.

claims.text: Guests have access to the hotel's luxury house car.

findings.quote: grand gestures like access to our luxury house car and thoughtful concierge service

claims.text: The Portrait Bar is named for the collection of artwork on its wood-paneled walls.

findings.quote: The Portrait Bar, named for the exceptional collection of artwork that adorns its wood-paneled walls

claims.text: After a 10-year restoration by Flâneur Hospitality, the original brick and limestone Renaissance-style palazzo is joined by a 24-story modern glass tower.

findings.quote: following a 10-year restoration by Flâneur Hospitality, the original brick and limestone Renaissance-style palazzo is complemented by a shimmering 24-story modern glass tower

claims.text: Designer Martin Brudnizki brought both the mansion and the tower to life in rich palettes and worldly curiosities.

findings.quote: the restored 1907 landmark stands beside a contemporary glass tower, with Martin Brudnizki bringing both to life in rich palettes and worldly curiosities

claims.text: The flâneur suite has a terrace with a Japanese garden and a soaking tub overlooking the New York skyline.

findings.quote: the flâneur suite that is accompanied by a palatial terrace complete with a Japanese garden with a soaking tub overlooking the New York skyline

claims.text: Signature Suites have a garden terrace with a view of Manhattan.

findings.quote: Entertain (or retreat) on a verdant garden terrace with a vista of Manhattan as your backdrop in one of our lavishly sized Signature Suites

claims.text: Guests can order a martini ritual to their room, where a martini butler stirs or shakes the drink.

findings.quote: the martini ritual which any guest can order to their room between 5:00 and 7:00 p.m.
a martini butler will arrive to stir—or shake—the perfect martini

claims.text: Public spaces are in the historic mansion, while most rooms and suites are in the modern glass tower.

findings.quote: While public spaces are situated in the main mansion, most rooms and suites are contained within the modern glass tower next door.

claims.text: Café Carmellini welcomes both hotel guests and visitors, and reservations are recommended.

findings.quote: Café Carmellini welcomes both hotel guests and visitors. Reservations are recommended.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of a Fifth Avenue location.
